title: Transfer: model a part

blocks.md:
## An object graph that matches a world part

Build `{ id, type, props }` like `world-v1`. `makePart("fox", { x: 1, y: 0 })` returns that shape. `movePart(part, "east")` increments `props.x`.

`part.props` is an object the engine can read (`x`, `y`…), not a string dump.

Two easts from x=0 put the modeled fox at x=2, the same way the stage fox walks.

blocks.explainMd: The stage reads fields on props. A printed string cannot increment x.

blocks.promptMd: > `makePart` + `movePart` east twice from x=0. Print the new x (`2`).

hintLadder.md: `makePart` returns `{ id, type, props }`. Copy `props` so callers cannot share one box by accident.
